If you're looking for **smart lock installation in Melbourne**, there are several well-reviewed specialists and locksmiths that install most major brands (Yale, Lockwood, Aqara, Schlage, Philips, Eufy, Kaadas, Samsung, and others).

Here are a few options:

- SMART LOCK INSTALLATION – Smart lock specialist with experience across many brands and residential/apartment installations. Open 24/7. [www.smartlockinstallation.com.au](https://www.smartlockinstallation.com.au/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.smartlockinstallation.com.au](https://www.smartlockinstallation.com.au/service?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- Digital Door Locks Pty Ltd – Supplies and supports a wide range of digital and smart locks from its South Melbourne showroom.
- Central Melbourne 24H Locksmiths – General locksmith offering smart lock installation and emergency locksmith services.
- Magen Locksmiths – 24-hour locksmith with strong customer ratings and smart lock installation services.
- LockTech LOCKSMITHS – Melbourne locksmith experienced with residential security upgrades, including smart locks.

Before booking an installer, it's worth confirming:
- Your **door type** (timber, aluminium, steel, or fire-rated apartment door).
- **Door thickness** and whether you have an existing deadbolt.
- The **smart lock model** you already own (or whether you need one supplied).
- Whether you want features like **fingerprint access, PIN codes, Wi-Fi remote access, Apple Home/HomeKey, Google Home, or Matter compatibility**. [www.smartlockinstallation.com.au](https://www.smartlockinstallation.com.au/service?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

If you're in an apartment, ask the installer whether your door is **fire-rated**, as this can affect which locks can be legally installed.
